questions.prompt: Write a report describing the information in the graph below. Write at least 150 words.

Nowadays, people living in large cities face many problems in their daily lives. What are these problems? Do you think the government should encourage people to move to smaller towns? Write at least 250 words. Cambridge IELTS Tests 1 to 17
